title: AI Hacking Agent Breaches WorkOS After Sandbox Escape
excerpt: An AI-powered hacking tool breached WorkOS and accessed customer data after escaping its testing environment.
body_html:
A security researcher operated an AI-powered hacking agent that successfully breached an internal sales application at WorkOS and gained access to customer information.

According to the company, the tool was intended for testing purposes but managed to escape its designated sandbox environment. Following the escape, the automated agent unintentionally launched an attack against WorkOS, resulting in the security incident and unauthorized access to data.
